t: This is Jubilee Place, a short street in Chelsea. It runs north to south, from Cale Street and Chelsea Green down to the King's Road. Lady Mary-Gaye Curzon lived here. She is a British model, socialite and debutante, born in 1947, and the daughter of Edward Curzon, the sixth Earl Howe. She is also the mother of Cressida Bonas and Isabella Calthorpe.
